data.narrative:
Terran Robotics is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Zach Dwiel and Danny Weddle. The company has raised $256K to date. The comparable universe in Robotics & Manufacturing includes 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics.

The stage-progression method is applicable here, using the $256K total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $640K. The peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient narrow comparables: while 10 same-sector peers exist, the filtered set (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier) contains fewer than three datapoints, making sector-wide medians unreliably broad.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to the single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $544K (low) to $736K (high), with a median of $640K. This range reflects a ±15% sensitivity band around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific company's progress trajectory and the absence of direct peer valuation anchors. Additional data on burn rate, runway, or investor composition would improve confidence in this estimate.
